input.summary: Complete DMC for each of three locks while leaving DELOREAN one letter short. Start multiball, then shoot a ramp to begin Million Round safely. Complete DMC during multiball to relight both ramp Jackpot ladders.

quickInfo.name: Million Round
quickInfo.summary: Spell DELOREAN with ramp shots to start 12 seconds of one-million ramp shots; later rounds can fall to six seconds.

quickInfo.name: Back to the Future Multiball
quickInfo.summary: On the first multiball, each DMC completion lights the next lock and three collected locks start three-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Ramp Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: The left and right ramps have independent Jackpot ladders: 500K, 750K, and 1M.

quickInfo.name: DMC relight
quickInfo.summary: Complete DMC during multiball to relight both ramp Jackpots for their next ladder values.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot completion
quickInfo.summary: Complete both three-step ramp ladders for an additional one-million award, then continue the relight cycle if balls remain.

steps.text: Complete DMC to light the first lock. Collect it, then repeat DMC and the lock saucer until two balls are locked.
Repeat controlled ramps until DELOREAN is one letter short. If the next ramp is unsafe, stop the setup and start Multiball; finish DELOREAN with protected ramp shots instead.
modeNotes: Million Round: Each non-skill-shot ramp adds a DELOREAN letter. Completing the word starts 12 seconds in which every ramp scores one million; later rounds can start with less time.

steps.text: Complete DMC once more, collect the third lock, and stabilize the three-ball release.
Shoot either ramp during multiball to complete DELOREAN and start Million Round without wasting its timer on the ball release.
modeNotes: Back to the Future Multiball: On the first cycle, each DMC completion lights one of three stackable locks. The third collected lock starts three-ball play.
Ramp Jackpot ladders: Each ramp scores 500K, then 750K, then 1M. The two ladders advance separately.

steps.text: Collect both lit ramp Jackpots. Complete DMC to relight each ramp at its next value.
Finish both ramp ladders for the additional one-million completion award. Repeat DMC relights while two or more balls remain.
After multiball, return to controlled ramp shots for another Million Round or rebuild DMC locks.

fallback.title: Ramp Million Round
fallback.when: Use this when lock shots or the saucer feed are unsafe.

steps.text: Alternate or repeat the safer ramp to spell DELOREAN.
Start Million Round.
Repeat the safest ramp for one million per shot until the timer ends.
Continue ramp progress and preserve any completed DMC letters for later locks.
Prepare Million Round and three locks.
Stack the timed million-point round with multiball when the final start is safe.
Use DMC relights to collect 500K, 750K, and 1M on each ramp.
Complete both ladders for the additional one-million award.

techniques.name: Ramp feed test
techniques.instruction: Use the first controlled shot to test each ramp return. Favor the ramp that returns to a reliable cradle or repeat shot.

techniques.name: Multiball ramp control
techniques.instruction: Trap one ball when possible. Use the other ball to alternate ramp Jackpots and finish DMC relights.

cautions.issue: The saucer eject can return toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Watch the first eject with both flippers ready. Do not delay a ready multiball for a saucer collect if its feed is unsafe.

cautions.issue: A weak right-ramp shot can reject toward the center or right outlane.
cautions.response: Use the left ramp as the main DELOREAN shot when the right entrance is not clean.

cautions.issue: General illumination becomes dark during some timed features and can hide the ball path.
cautions.response: Do not change to an untested shot during a dark effect. Keep using the known ramp or trap until normal lighting returns.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the installed production ROM, tournament settings, lock difficulty, Million Round timer, Jackpot memory, Extra Ball conversion, and award treatment.
Check whether later DMC qualifications require ordered hits and whether partial Jackpot ladders carry into the next multiball.
Test both ramp returns, lock-saucer entry and eject, Clock Tower eject, right-ramp rejects, and the dark McFLY lighting effect.

input.simpleOverview: Back to the Future uses D-M-C for three locks and D-E-L-O-R-E-A-N for a timed Million Round. Leave the word one letter short, start Multiball, finish D-M-C to relight both ramp Jackpot ladders, then start Million Round with the extra balls protecting its ramp shots.
input.overview: Each D-M-C completion lights the next of three locks in Back to the Future; the third lock starts Multiball. During Multiball, each ramp advances its own 500K, 750K, and 1M Jackpot ladder, and another D-M-C completion relights both ramps. Ramp shots also spell D-E-L-O-R-E-A-N for a short Million Round, so leave the word one letter short before the third lock.
